name: qspec
description: Write, check, sign, select, and freeze research questions as Question Specs: a claim that can fail, a method family, materials, increment over named work, and a kill condition. Bundles the qspec tool and the core and domain schemas. It measures and records; it never writes a field or judges whether a question is good.
author: RealTimeX

skills.name: qspec
skills.description: Turn a research topic into a Question Spec that can be linted, signed, selected, frozen, or killed, and hand the frozen question to Paperforge. Does not author the question.
